main_text.head: 9. SOZIMVS Græcus.
main_text.p: Sozimus Græcus constituit, ut cereus sabbato sancto benediceretur, & ut in celebrationibus, diaconi læuas lynostimis tectas haberent. Vetuit etiā ut clerici in publico biberent, aut tabernas fouerent[?], ac ne serui in clerum reciperentur. Et anno Domini 420. rebus humanis confessor excessit.
main_text.head: 10. BONIFACIVS Romanus.
main_text.p: Bonifacius Romanus, sacerdotis lucundi filius, in magna cleri seditione electus, ualde necessarias c(si diis placet) constitutiones fecit, scilicet, ne mulier, quamuis velata monacha, altaris palam aut uasa attingat sacra, neque incensum adoleat: nec ante tricesimum ætatis annum sacerdos quisquam ordinetur. Hic anno Domini 426. post institutas sanctorum uigilias, confessor occubuit.
main_text.head: 11. COELESTINVS Campanus.

page.notes: Printed "c" marks in the right margin are read as reference marks and given as notes; their exact positions in the lines are approximate. The page number "31" is partly blurred; read as 31 with [?]. The running head numeral is read as II with [?]. Words "plum", "fouerent", "propria mueta" and the first "sanctorum" are doubtful. Initial "s" and "f" forms are read as s where the sense requires. Heading numbers 9, 10, 11 are kept as printed. The word "dotes" at the lower right is treated as a catchword.
